SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS total_profit FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1
